Everyone panicked when Anthropic IPO’d for ~$180B while Figma traded below $10B despite being worth roughly twice as much before ChatGPT’s explosion. Growth rates across public software companies cratered—Salesforce downgraded full-year guidance in January 2025, HubSpot missed earnings again (four straight quarters), MongoDB saw stock prices plummet after beating expectations by just two cents per share. Even the “AI beneficiaries” like Monday.com got hammered on fears their business would cannibalize seats rather than expand them. But here’s what everyone missed: private markets didn’t believe the narrative. While public stocks were getting crushed, PE firms kept buying.
